notes.title: Unveiling 'The Last Bot': Decode the Silence with Seeker-3
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Steam Community,[/h1]

I'm ecstatic to lift the curtain on [i]The Last Bot[/i], a game that's not just another post-apocalyptic tale but a narrative-driven experience crafted with care as a solo developer.

Development has been well under way for some time and I'm happy to announce it with a teaser trailer:
[previewyoutube=nM1jNDZoGKw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]🤖 Who is Seeker-3?[/h2]
Imagine waking up alone in a city where skyscrapers are jungles and skywalks are pathways to the past. That's the reality for Seeker-3, a robot with a knack for repair and a circuit full of questions.

[h2]🌆 Mile High City: A Silent Echo[/h2]
This isn't your typical abandoned city. Mile High City is a vertical labyrinth (see my other game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1366560/MiLE_HiGH_TAXi/]MiLE HiGH TAXi[/url]), where each landing holds clues to its past glory and present decay. Vines crawl up rusted metal, and defunct robots and electronics tell stories more vivid than words.

[h2]🔧 More Than Repairs[/h2]
It's not just about fixing what's broken. It's about choosing who to fix. Will you spend your limited resources on a robot who offers cryptic advice or one who can boost your own systems?

[h2]🎮 Why Just Survive, When You Can Thrive?[/h2]
Survival isn't the endgame. It's the choices you make, the robots you repair, and the secrets you uncover that define your journey.

[h2]📅 Join the Quest[/h2]
I'll be sharing exclusive peeks into the game's development, including how I'm bringing the dialogue system and repair mechanics to life. So add [i]The Last Bot[/i] to your wishlist and stay tuned for a journey that promises more than just answers.

Together, let's decode the silence that haunts Mile High City. Thank you for your support.

Best,
Cassius (solo developer)
